kjv: and Satan standing at his (Joshua's) right hand to resist him
mine: and the Accuser standing at his (Joshua's) right hand to accuse him
note: hassatan has the article ("the adversary/accuser"), a role in the heavenly court as in Job 1-2, with a wordplay on lesitno "to accuse him"; KJV's proper name "Satan" imports the later figure of the devil.
